name: Ondřej Kolář - Après le § 13 - Am 12
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Bosnia and Herzegovina
part_text: 13a. Is concerned about Türkiye’s deepening political, economic and cultural influence on Bosnia and Herzegovina; is concerned about Türkiye’s growing presence through direct investments, religious institutions, bilateral agreements and political support for specific communities;
